response.justification: Bogdan Szabo's extensive experience as a Senior Fullstack Developer aligns well with the role's requirements. His recent work in AI-agent infrastructure, strong TypeScript and Node.js background, and experience with React and MongoDB demonstrate relevant technical skills. His diverse roles and contributions to open-source projects highlight adaptability and a customer-oriented approach.
strengths: 9+ years of fullstack development experience with modern stacks (TypeScript, Node.js, React)
Experience with AI-agent infrastructure and modern tooling (MCP, developer tooling)
Proven track record in optimizing performance, scalability, and user experience across multiple domains
concerns: Limited direct experience with Nest.js, the primary backend framework in the job description
Some roles focus on non-primary stacks (D, Swift) which may dilute recent fullstack relevance
GitLab and CI/CD experience is mentioned but not explicitly tied to current industry standards
